answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, diluted when peers disagree, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The beacon of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A island of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pearl of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
